read.thesis: Q2 PBT up 13% to $10.3bn with 19.5% annualised RoTE; Banking NII guidance raised to at least $46bn and buybacks resumed at up to $1bn, though CIB deposit growth is half short-term.

triggers.label: Banking NII guidance raised to $46bn
triggers.quote: We are upgrading our full year banking NII guidance to at least USD 46 billion.

triggers.label: Simplification saves raised to $2bn
triggers.quote: we are today revising upwards our total target savings to USD 2 billion.

triggers.label: Q2 deposits up $46bn, CIB half short-term
triggers.quote: about half of the CIB deposit growth in the quarter was large and short term.

triggers.label: 15 business and market exits since 2025
triggers.quote: We have now announced 15 business or market exits since 2025.

guidance.quote: We are upgrading our full year banking NII guidance to at least USD 46 billion.
we continue to guide on around 1% cost growth for the full year '26.
we are today revising upwards our total target savings to USD 2 billion.
We reiterate our full year credit guidance of around 45 basis points.
Return on tangible equity of 17% or better, excluding notable items each year.
We reiterate the targets we set out at the full year, revenue rising to 5% year-on-year growth by 2028

prior_guidance_check.quote: We have now exceeded this target, reaching USD 1.7 billion of action saves.
Cost growth this quarter is 1% year-on-year.
We reiterate our full year credit guidance of around 45 basis points.
Annualized return on tangible equity for the quarter was 19.5%

red_flags.label: Mid-market credit pressure UK and Asia
red_flags.quote: we have seen small pockets of mid-market credit pressure in the U.K. and across Asia.

red_flags.label: Half of CIB deposit growth short-term
red_flags.quote: about half of the CIB deposit growth in the quarter was large and short term.

evasions.topic: Share price vs inorganic M&A currency
evasions.quote: the share price is a matter for our shareholders to opine on.
we are not commenting on consensus or giving a cost guidance for 2027.
